evidence: Matches the 'Build system' and 'Windows' labels and edits CMakeLists.txt and cmake/module/GetMingwVersion.cmake to inspect and log the cross-compilation toolchain.
rationale: Adds diagnostic logging of the MinGW-w64 version to the CMake configuration summary. While helpful for debugging toolchain-specific issues (citing PR #34578), it is a minor contributor convenience that does not impact build integrity, reproducibility, or fix any build failures.
